retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-inspired layout featuring a central square photograph of a group in a natural setting, enclosed by a thick matte border and overlaid with expressive, hand-drawn white script.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A square photograph of a group of people sitting in a sun-dappled forest clearing, framed by a wide, solid-colored matte border with a thin white inner stroke. The composition is unified by organic, white hand-lettered script placed at the top and bottom of the image area.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square image nested within a wide, dark border
Organic white script contrasting against complex natural textures
Muted, warm sunlight tones in the photo balanced by a cool-toned frame
Horizontal alignment of the group mirroring the horizontal flow of the text
coreInvariants: Thin white inner keyline framing the photo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of six people arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds of the central square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central group of figures, particularly the person in the foreground left with dark clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top script, moves down to the group of people, and finishes at the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the wide outer border and the upper third of the photograph (trees/sky).

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal or forest green (outer border)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm earth tones, browns, and muted greens (photograph)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout, giving a faded, vintage film appearance.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, textured edges suggesting chalk or dry brush
Connected lowercase letters with expressive, elongated ascenders and descenders
Inconsistent slant and height for a handmade feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters are larger and more ornate but maintain the same brush texture
Terminals end in soft, tapered points

composition.position: top and bottom of the photo area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text elements to maintain a unified handmade aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the textured, organic feel of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph of a group of people in 1970s attire sitting in a sunlit forest clearing. Place this square inside a wide, dark teal border with a thin white inner stroke separating the photo from the border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, white dry-brush script text at the top and bottom of the photograph area, ensuring the letters have a slightly rough, organic texture.

verificationChecks: Is the border wide and solid-colored?
Is there a thin white line between the photo and the border?
Does the text look hand-painted rather than digitally typed?
Is the photo lighting soft and naturalistic?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the photo
Intensity of the brush texture in the text
Width of the white inner frame

avoid: Perfectly straight digital lines in the text

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the text is legible despite the textured edges.
Ensure the white inner frame is consistent in thickness.
Check that the group portrait feels candid and natural.
Verify the color palette remains within muted, earthy tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square photo + Wide matte border + Thin inner stroke + Hand-drawn white script overlay = 70s Folk Aesthetic.
